defect: The new texture-coordinate wrapping uses fmod(s, 1.0f), which keeps negative coordinates negative, so u = s * width becomes a huge unsigned texel index and reads out of bounds.
reason: The fix replaces exactly the fmod wrapping lines this change added with s -= floor(s), and the change's own TODO flags the negative case.

defect: The moved Thin3DFormatToFormatAndType turns the former ELOG in the default case into _assert_msg_, so a readback with an unsupported format (for example S8 on GLES) crashes instead of returning false.
reason: The parent version only logged; this change added the always-on assert that the fix removes, and seeing that callers pass unsupported formats needs the readback code.

defect: On this file the fix only deletes the unused prim topology table; the actual crash fix (setting key.topology) is in StateMappingVulkan.cpp.
reason: The fix's change to this file is a move of dead code, not a repair of a defect in lines of this file.

defect: The new GraphicsScreen shows a Frame Skipping checkbox bound to a local bool fs but never writes it back to g_Config.iFrameSkip, so the checkbox has no effect.
reason: Besides spacing tweaks, the fix adds the missing g_Config.iFrameSkip = fs ? 1 : 0 line to code this change added; the PauseScreen pattern above shows the write-back.

defect: The fix restores a window that was maximized before going fullscreen and re-maximizes it on exit; the change only swapped g_Config.bFullScreen for the equivalent goingFullscreen.
reason: Callers set bFullScreen before calling, so the change is behaviour-neutral and the maximized-state handling was missing before it.

defect: The fix removes the +12 - x / +12 - y texel offsetting from GetTexelCoordinates.
reason: The offset existed verbatim in Rasterizer.cpp and Sampler.cpp before this change, which only moved the code.

defect: The fix removes the X/Y (12 - x) offset from the jitted texel coordinate calculation.
reason: The NEG/ADD 12 offset predates this change, which only vectorised the existing computation.

defect: InitializeFromID decodes the id without the w0fmt/w1fmt weight fields that ComputeID later packs into the low bits.
reason: At this change DecVtxFormat had no weight fields and InitializeFromID exactly inverted ComputeID; the mismatch came from the later revert 69309aa that re-added weights.

defect: samplesToRead = (sampleFrac + pitch * (grainSize - delay)) >> shift goes negative when delay exceeds grainSize.
reason: The same formula existed before this change (from the December interpolation rewrite); the change only renamed voice.pitch to voicePitch.

defect: The fix adds KeyMap:: qualification to functions that were defined at global scope.
reason: This change wrapped everything in namespace KeyMap correctly; the namespace was dropped later by 79e6d49 ('Fix inconsistent namespace usage').

defect: The new clo implementation computes RSB(R0, rs, 0), the two's-complement negation, instead of the bitwise NOT before CLZ, so count-leading-ones is wrong.
reason: The fix replaces exactly that RSB with an EOR against 0xFFFFFFFF; negation versus NOT is visible from the diff.

defect: On this file the fix only adds a line counter and reformats the DIFF log output of the test runner.
reason: The fix repairs the ARM JIT elsewhere; its TestRunner change is a logging improvement, not a defect fix.

defect: The fix replaces the bool default false of the int UIScaleFactor setting with a function returning -1 on Windows and 0 elsewhere.
reason: false converts to the intended 0; the fix silences a warning and retunes a platform default, which is configuration rather than a defect.

defect: The new Android text drawer measures and renders strings without collapsing the '&&' escape to '&', so UI labels show doubled ampersands.
reason: The fix adds NormalizeString to exactly the MeasureString/DrawString lines this change added; that '&&' must be collapsed is only visible from the Qt/Win32 drawers.

defect: The new #if XR_USE_GRAPHICS_API_OPENGL guards exclude OpenGL ES builds, so the Quest/Android VR build compiles PreprocessStepVR as a no-op and the sky plane fix stops working.
reason: The fix extends exactly these two guards to XR_USE_GRAPHICS_API_OPENGL_ES; knowing that Android VR defines only the _ES macro needs other files.

defect: The new Core_RunLoop sets coreState = CORE_RUNNING after GL_SwapBuffers, overwriting a pause or quit state another thread set during the swap.
reason: The fix moves the assignment before the swap; the race is visible from the diff, since coreState is documented in the same file as written from anywhere.

defect: The UNICODE port stores ConvertUTF8ToWString(...).c_str() of temporaries in OPENFILENAME (dangling pointers, filters truncated at the first embedded NUL) and casts the UTF-8 _strFileName buffer to wchar_t*.
reason: The fix changes the parameters to wchar_t and copies the file name with wcscpy, repairing exactly the lines this change added; temporaries' lifetimes are visible in the diff.

defect: The fix passes wide-string arguments to BrowseForFileName after its signature changed in the UNICODE port.
reason: This change only added the browse-directory branch; the call it touched was unchanged in substance and the mismatch came from the later UNICODE switch.

defect: On Symbian AllocateMemoryPages calls mmap with fd -1 and MAP_PRIVATE but without MAP_ANON, which is not an anonymous mapping and fails, so allocation breaks.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this Symbian mmap path with new u8[size] (and delete[] on free); fd -1 without MAP_ANON is visibly invalid.

defect: The fix capitalises the Ukrainian language name in the language list.
reason: This is a cosmetic text change, not a functional defect.

defect: Moving the backbuffer bind into an else branch leaves no render target bound when CopyDisplayToOutput presents nothing (for example after toggling Skip buffer effects while paused), so the following darken/UI draw crashes.
reason: Before the change the backbuffer was always bound; the fix binds it whenever nothing was presented, and knowing CopyDisplayToOutput may not bind needs the GPU code.

defect: The fix lets Atrac3+ decoding work when no block align is given, by defaulting it in atrac3p_alloc and taking it from the input size.
reason: Eager atrac3p_alloc with a zero block align already failed after 6ea8efc0; this change only reordered the arguments consistently and removed AVCodecContext for ATRAC3.

defect: The fix translates the chat button with the Networking category instead of the Screen category.
reason: The chat button code did not exist in this change, which only switched I18NCategory pointers to auto.

defect: The fix moves the chat and quick-chat labels from the System/Controls translation categories to Networking.
reason: This change only added (const char *) casts to resolve an ambiguity; the category choice predates it.

defect: The new GetSymbolInfo returns the unique entry found by start address without checking that it extends past the queried address, so with duplicates it can return a symbol that does not contain it and callers advancing by its size loop forever.
reason: The fix adds the missing end-address check to exactly this new fast path, whose own comment concedes that entries may overlap.

defect: The fix restores the R/G/B order of the material ambient colour in the software transform.
reason: This change used the correct order (R = bits 0-7); the swapped channels came from later commits 79bd4e3 and 39d3b76.

defect: Changing the AutoRun default to false makes every game start paused (startBreak = !bAutoRun) on all platforms, just to make the Qt 'Break on load' checkbox look right.
reason: The stage-2 fix reverts this line and fixes the Qt menu with addEventUnchecked; flipping a run-behaviour default is visible from the diff.

defect: myVector.reserve(entry->children.size() - 2) underflows size_t when a directory has fewer than two children, so reserve throws or crashes.
reason: The fix removes exactly this added line; the unsigned underflow is visible from the diff.

defect: The fix checks only write readiness while connecting and passes null fd sets to select, as part of a PTP socket performance fix.
reason: The read-and-write readiness check was already used before this change, so the fix is a cleanup, not a repair of a defect it introduced.

defect: The fix defines SD_BOTH as SHUT_RDWR instead of the literal 0x02.
reason: SHUT_RDWR is 2 on the supported POSIX platforms, so the fix is stylistic.

defect: The new applyRoundingMode stub branches past the js.currentRoundingFunc update when it skips the FPCR change, and currentRoundingFunc is never initialised, so float-to-int conversions can use a stale rounding function.
reason: The fix moves the skip target before the update and initialises currentRoundingFunc; seeing why a stale value matters needs the FPU compiler that uses it.

defect: The new fontconfig fallback code calls FcFini() in the TextDrawerSDL destructor, which crashes on shutdown.
reason: The fix comments out exactly this added call; the crash comes from fontconfig's FcFini behaviour, which the code does not show.

defect: The fix only rewords two comments about fontHash_.
reason: This is a documentation change.

defect: The fix only moves the opening brace of CGEDebugger::init onto the same line.
reason: This is a whitespace and style change.

defect: The fix sizes the vertex push buffer for indexed draws by the merged index ranges instead of the index counts.
reason: The push-buffer sizing loop is unchanged context in this change, which only split out DecodeVertsStep and added UV prescale.

defect: The fix passes the renamed variable pa instead of the undeclared p to ScreenshotViewScreen (a compile error).
reason: This change declared and used p consistently; 54d0b46 renamed it to pa without updating the use.

defect: In GamepadUpdateOpacity the coreState check runs before the force argument, so the touch-control editor hides buttons when no game is running.
reason: The force parameter and the removal of the editor's forceVisible_/GetButtonOpacity overrides came in the next commit, 6318137; at this change the editor still forced its own opacity.

defect: With FindReplacement now returning nullptr when there is no replacement, 'if (replaced && replaced->IsInvalid()) ... else { match = false; }' sends the null case to the else branch and needlessly invalidates the texture (and plan.replaced->Valid() can dereference null).
reason: Previously FindNone() was invalid and took the first branch; the fix restructures exactly these lines so that null does nothing.

defect: The scissored-clear change no longer re-enables GL_SCISSOR_TEST after a clear and explicitly disables it after a scissored clear, so later draws run without scissoring.
reason: The original code re-enabled scissor after every clear; the fix restores the always-on invariant, and the removed glEnable shows it in the diff.

defect: The new sceHeapGetTotalFreeSize dereferences heapList[heapAddr] without a null check, and heapList is never cleared or given a serialisable Heap DoState.
reason: The fix adds the null check (and init and DoState) to the functions this change implemented; the unchecked dereference is visible in the diff.
